title: Detection of Single Nucleotide Polymorphisms with Padlock Probes
author: Tomasz Krzywkowski
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.wjhfcj6
materials: Culture cells in a flask until 80-90% confluence.

Combine the reagents in the table below for the RCA mix.

Remove PBS-T and add combined ligation mix reagents to the chamber. Cover the chamber inlets and incubate the slides in a humidity chamber at 37°C for ≥1 hour. (see Note 15) 37 °C 01:00:00, RCA Note 15: The optimal temperature for phi29 polymerase is 37°C. We typically conduct RCA for 1 hour. If RCA is performed for several hours (or overnight) at 37°C, RCPs may start to fragment what could interfere with accurate signal counting. If large RCPs are desired (thick tissue sections or those with high autofluorescence), we advise doing RCA at RT overnight. Such approach will generate very large but compact RCPs.

steps.title: Trypsinize adherent cells
steps.instruction: Wash cells twice with PBS, add 1 mL per 25 cm² of 0.25 % Trypsin‑EDTA, incubate 1–2 min, then aspirate and monitor detachment under a bright‑field microscope.

steps.title: Resuspend cells in medium
steps.instruction: Resuspend the detached cells in appropriate culture medium (note: fetal bovine serum inactivates trypsin).

steps.title: Prepare slides and medium
steps.instruction: Place sterile microscope slides in a 150 mm × 25 mm culture dish, add ~22 mL of medium to fully cover the slides.

steps.title: Seed cells onto slides
steps.instruction: Carefully pipette a total of 3 mL of the suspended cells onto the slides (density may be adjusted per cell line).

steps.title: Incubate cells to adhere
steps.instruction: Transfer the closed dish to a humidified incubator (37 °C, 5 % CO₂) and incubate overnight (or until cells form a homogeneous layer).

steps.title: Wash slides with cold PBS
steps.instruction: Wash the slides twice with cold PBS, then place the slides in a sterile Coplin jar or transport box.

steps.title: Fix cells with formaldehyde
steps.instruction: Fix cells by adding 3.7 % formaldehyde (in DEPC‑PBS) at room temperature for 20 min (cell post‑fixation can be 10 min; tissue fixation up to 45 min).

steps.title: Discard fixative and wash
steps.instruction: Dispose of formaldehyde according to safety guidelines, then wash the slides twice with PBS.

steps.title: Dehydrate and pre‑permeabilize
steps.instruction: Pass the slides through an ethanol series: 70 % EtOH 3 min, 85 % EtOH 3 min, 99.5 % EtOH 3 min.

steps.title: Air‑dry slides
steps.instruction: Allow the slides to air‑dry; for long‑term storage keep at –80 °C (or –20 °C for ≤2 weeks) with proper labeling.

steps.title: Attach Secure‑Seal chamber
steps.instruction: Attach a Secure‑Seal chamber of appropriate size, add PBS‑T to rehydrate the cells (tilt the slide slightly to avoid bubbles).

steps.title: Permeabilize with HCl
steps.instruction: Remove PBS‑T, add 0.1 M HCl, incubate 5 min at room temperature, then discard HCl.

steps.title: Wash chamber with PBS‑T
steps.instruction: Wash the cells twice with PBS‑T.

steps.title: Cryosection tissue onto slides
steps.instruction: Cryosection tissue at ~10 µm thickness, mount sections on microscope slides (e.g., SuperFrost Plus), and store at –80 °C until use.

steps.title: Thaw tissue slides
steps.instruction: Thaw frozen tissue slides at room temperature for a few minutes.

steps.title: Fix tissue sections
steps.instruction: Fix the tissue in 3.7 % formaldehyde for 45 min at room temperature (use a sterile Coplin jar or fix directly on the slide).

steps.title: Wash tissue with PBS
steps.instruction: Wash the fixed tissue once with PBS for 5 min.

steps.title: Optional pepsin permeabilization
steps.instruction: Incubate the tissue with pre‑warmed pepsin (250 U/mL, 0.1 mg/mL) in 0.1 M HCl at 37 °C for 5 min; optimize conditions for each specimen.

steps.title: Wash after pepsin
steps.instruction: Wash the tissue once with PBS for 5 min.

steps.title: Dehydrate tissue sections
steps.instruction: Pass the tissue through the same ethanol series as cells: 70 % EtOH 3 min, 85 % EtOH 3 min, 99.5 % EtOH 3 min.

steps.title: Mount Secure‑Seal chamber on tissue
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the tissue, then place an appropriately sized Secure‑Seal chamber on the slide.

steps.title: Hybridize primers at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Cover chamber inlets, incubate at 37 °C: 1 h with LNA‑modified target‑specific primers or overnight with random decamers for reverse transcription.

steps.title: Wash chamber with PBS‑T
steps.instruction: Wash the chamber twice with PBS‑T.

steps.title: Hybridize PLPs at 45 °C
steps.instruction: Transfer the humidity chamber to a 45 °C incubator and incubate for 45 min (RNase H activity at 37 °C, Tth ligase optimal at 45 °C; formamide may be added to lower duplex Tm).

steps.title: Mark and remove chamber
steps.instruction: Mark the chamber position on the slide backside with a diamond pen, then remove the Secure‑Seal chamber (use a double‑edge razor if needed).

steps.title: Final dehydration of slides
steps.instruction: Dehydrate the slides through ethanol series again: 70 % EtOH 3 min, 85 % EtOH 3 min, 99.5 % EtOH 3 min, then air‑dry.

steps.title: Mount with antifade medium
steps.instruction: Apply 5–7 µL of Slow‑Fade® Gold Antifade mounting medium (for a 50 µL chamber), gently place a coverslip, and remove excess medium with a paper towel.

steps.title: Dewax paraffin‑embedded sections (optional)
steps.instruction: Submerge slides sequentially: 15 min xylene, 10 min xylene, 2 × 2 min 100 % EtOH, 2 × 2 min 95 % EtOH, 2 × 2 min 70 % EtOH, 5 min DEPC‑H₂O, 5 min PBS (handle xylene with care).

steps.title: Pepsin permeabilization after dewax
steps.instruction: Incubate dewaxed tissue with pre‑warmed pepsin in 0.1 M HCl at 37 °C for 5 min (same conditions as above).

steps.title: Post‑fix tissue
steps.instruction: Fix the tissue in 3.7 % formaldehyde for 10 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Final PBS washes
steps.instruction: Wash twice with PBS, 5 min each.

steps.title: Final ethanol dehydration
steps.instruction: Dehydrate again through 70 %, 85 %, and 99.5 % ethanol, 3 min each, then air‑dry.

steps.title: Image slides
steps.instruction: Image the mounted slides on a wide‑field epifluorescence microscope (e.g., Zeiss Axioplan II) using appropriate filter sets (e.g., 38HE for FITC, SP102v2 for Cy3, etc.), acquire 5–10 µm z‑stacks, and generate maximum‑intensity projections.

steps.title: Analyze images
steps.instruction: Process images with CellProfiler or ImageJ: segment nuclei and cytoplasm, identify rolling‑circle amplification products, assign RCPs to cells, and export counts as a .csv file.
